lines.trans: Friends, I have gathered all of you here.
Let's talk. Come with me.
And here is what I thought.
All of you should work like Denis.
Peeling potatoes by the sack?
No, more efficiently.
If everyone works like Denis,
The coefficient of useful efficiency will rise.
We will not need such a large number of cooks.
